text_block_list.text:
After declaring "I'll definitely get one!",
I tried my best to get at least one... but failed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
choice_data_list: (I wonder if she's disappointed in me...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you all finished with your business?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was the same Mejiro Ramonu as always.
In the end, all that mattered to her was the race.
choice_data_list: (Maybe she just wasn't interested to begin with...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
